mission.title: kserve: Add a new inference routing type: Mirroring
mission.description: Add a new inference routing type: Mirroring. Requested by 11+ users.

steps.title: Check current kserve deployment
steps.description:
Verify your kserve version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve
helm list -n kserve 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working kserve installation.

steps.title: Review kserve configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kserve configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve
kubectl get configmap -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kserve
```
We are facing a new use case: we want to add a testing branch to an online service(main branch), this testing branch will get some of online queries, but we don't want the testing branch response.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Add a new inference routing type: Mirroring
Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve
kubectl get events -n kserve --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Add a new inference routing type: Mirroring" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: See the source issue for the community-verified solution: https://github.com/kserve/kserve/issues/2240

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with kserve installed or the issue environment reproducible.
